scientific_question: Does quotienting the sparse-MoE trajectory into independently moving paired hidden-neuron atoms reveal a causal low-dimensional chart at a coordinate budget consistent with the Mapping Networks paper's 200x to 500x regime?

causal_basis.rule: For transition t to t+1, every atom basis may use only matched chords ending at or before t. The target and future chords are excluded from basis construction.

functional_gauge.atom: One incoming c_fc row and its coupled outgoing c_proj column, R_ej(X) = GELU(X a_ej) outer b_ej.
functional_gauge.matching: Sequential maximum-weight assignment on discovery-split functional-atom similarity, with heldout assignment agreement reported before scoring.
functional_gauge.scale: Retain paired magnitudes after matching because GELU is not positively homogeneous.
functional_gauge.expert_identity: Within-run expert identity remains coupled to its router row.

coordinate_families.name: coupled_four
coordinate_families.basis: The four most recent causal concatenated [delta_c_fc_row, delta_c_proj_column] atom chords.
coordinate_families.coordinate_fit: Least-squares projection of the target paired parameter chord onto that causal atom span; this is a representability upper bound, not a trainable predictor.
coordinate_families.router: Four most recent causal router-row chords per expert.

coordinate_families.name: separate_three_plus_three
coordinate_families.basis: The three most recent incoming-row chords and three most recent outgoing-column chords are projected separately, while hidden identity remains paired.
coordinate_families.coordinate_fit: Separate least-squares parameter projections provide the less constrained 256x upper bound.
coordinate_families.router: Three most recent causal router-row chords per expert.

controls.static: Use the earliest causal atom chords at the identical coordinate count and freeze them for every heldout transition.
controls.fixed_structured: Use deterministic shared local BlockFHT directions at the identical per-atom coordinate count, with independent frozen seeds for incoming, outgoing, and router pieces.
controls.power_recovery: Run the continuous replay branch first. If a gate is near threshold, repeat with authoritative pre-power steps 7128/7722/8316; no branch may be silently spliced.

evaluation.primary_metric: Exact nonlinear heldout residual-write recovery after materializing every projected paired atom and router row.

interpretation.coupled_four_pass: A paired-atom causal decoder is representable at approximately 384x coordinate compression; implement only this family and then gate its coordinate predictor and exact-config MFU before training.
interpretation.only_separate_pass: Incoming and outgoing directions require distinct coordinates; implement the 256x family and keep coupling only in identity and functional losses.
interpretation.both_fail: Temporal atom chords are not a sufficient mapping image. Do not train another trajectory-chart generator; move to an input-conditioned or data-derived adaptive basis oracle.
interpretation.authorization: No generated-expert training, larger active rung, or MFU preflight is authorized by this plan itself. A passing offline representability gate authorizes implementation tests at 124M only.
